name: α-methylmethcathinone
summary: α-Methylmethcathinone (α-Me-MC), also known as βk-mephentermine or as RAD-081, is a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) of the amphetamine, cathinone, and phentermine families. It is the α-methyl analogue of methcathinone and the β-keto analogue of mephentermine.

pharmacology.text: α-Methylmethcathinone (α-Me-MC), also known as βk-mephentermine or as RAD-081, is a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) of the amphetamine, cathinone, and phentermine families.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has been reported as a designer drug. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，也曾被報告作為設計師藥物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，也曾被报告作为设计师药物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: It sits at the meeting point of three families: it is methcathinone with an extra methyl group, and also the ketone version of the appetite suppressant mephentermine.
fact.zh: 它處在三個家族的交會處：它是甲基卡西酮多一個甲基的版本，同時也是食慾抑制劑mephentermine的酮基版本。
fact.zhHans: 它处在三个家族的交会处：它是甲基卡西酮多一个甲基的版本，同时也是食欲抑制剂mephentermine的酮基版本。
